NDA 2 Admit Card 2026 Out upsc.gov.in

The NDA 2 Admit Card 2026 has been uploaded by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) for the National Defence Academy and Naval Academy Examination (II), 2026. The NDA 2 Exam 2026 is scheduled to be conducted on 13th September 2026 (Sunday) across India. Candidates can download their e-Admit Card from the official UPSC website. Candidates must carry a printed copy of the e-Admit Card to the allotted examination venue. They must also carry the photo ID card mentioned on the admit card in each session.

Download UPSC NDS Admit Card Notice PDF

NDA 2 Admit Card Overview

NDA 2 Admit Card is now available online on the official website of UPSC. Candidates have to download it before the exam date i.e., 13 September 2026. Check the key details of the admit card below.

Particulars Details
Exam Name NDA Examination II 2026
Conducting Body Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)
Exam Date 13 September 2026
Total Vacancies 394
Admit Card Mode Online
NDA 2 Admit Card Release Date 3rd September 2026
Official Website upsc.gov.in

NDA 2 Admit Card Download Link

NDA 2 Admit Card Download link is available on the official website. Candidates can use the link to access and download hall tickets. Enter the requisite login details to view admit card. It is important to download the admit card early and keep a printed copy for the exam day. Below we have provided the direct link to download for easy access.

NDA 2 Admit Card 2026 – Click Here to Download

How to Download NDA 2 Admit Card 2026?

Candidates can download NDA II Admit Card 2026 from the official website. It is important to keep the registration details ready before starting the process. Candidates can follow the steps below to get hall ticket easily

  • Visit official website @upsc.gov.in
  • Go to e-Admit Card section available on the homepage
  • Select NDA 2 Admit Card 2026
  • Enter Registration ID/ Roll Number and Date of Birth
  • Click on Submit Button
  • Verify details mentioned on admit card
  • Download admit card
  • Take a clear print out for exam day

Download Here NDA Previous Year Question Paper

What Details are Mentioned on NDA II Admit Card 2026?

NDA 2 Admit Card 2026 contains important details about candidate and exam. Check all information carefully after downloading the hall ticket. Candidates must make sure that all details match with the application form. The details are mentioned on the admit card are as follows

  • Name of Candidate
  • Roll Number
  • Registration/ Roll Number
  • Photograph & Signature
  • NDA 2 Exam Date
  • Exam Timing
  • Exam Centre Name & Address
  • Important Exam Instructions

Check Here NDA Syllabus and Exam Pattern

Documents to Carry Along with NDA 2 Admit Card

Candidates have to carry required documents to the examination centre. Candidates have to keep admit card and valid photo ID ready before leaving for the examination. Candidates must carry the following documents along with admit card

  • NDA 2 Admit Card
  • Valid Photo ID Proof such as Aadhar Card, Voter ID, Passport, Driving License or PAN Card
  • Any other document as specified by the conducting body

What are NDA 2 Exam Timings?

NDA II 2026 Exam will be conducted in two sessions on 13 September 2026. Mathematics is held in the morning while the GAT paper is conducted in the afternoon. Candidates should reach the examination venue at least 30 minutes before the examination.

Session Paper Time
Morning Paper I – Mathematics 10:00 AM – 12:30 PM
Afternoon Paper II – General Ability Test (GAT) 2:00 PM – 4:30 PM

NDA 2 Exam Day Guidelines 2026

Candidates must read all instructions given on the NDA 2 Admit Card 2026 before the examination. Follow the rules at the examination centre to avoid any issues. The exam day guidelines are as follows

  • Candidates must reach the examination centre at least 30 minutes before the exam
  • Carry admit card, valid ID proof, stationary items including pen, pencil, eraser
  • Do not carry mobile phones, smartwatches, calculators or other electronic devices
  • Do not fold, tear or damage OMR Sheet
  • Open Question Booklet only when it is instructed by the Invigilator
  • Any malpractice may result in disqualification

NDA 2 Admit Card 2026 FAQs

Question: Is NDA 2 Admit Card 2026 released?

Answer: The admit card has been released on 3rd September 2026 by the Union Public Service Commission on the official website @upsc.gov.in.

Question: How can I download the NDA II Admit Card 2026?

Answer: Visit official website of UPSC, navigate to E-Admit Card section available on the homepage. Select NDA 2 Admit Card and enter registration details to download admit card.

Question: What is NDA 2 Exam Date 2026?

Answer: The exam is scheduled to held on 13 September 2026 in two sessions respectively.

Question: How many NDA 2 Vacancy have been notified?

Answer: A total of 394 vacancies have been announced.

Question: What should I carry to the exam centre?

Answer: Carry a printed copy of NDA 2 Admit Card and valid photo ID proof.
